primary_comparisons.T3: N + R = N0 + R0 per population (every drive's half-steps), per-cell sums of dA and dC zero; the planted dropped unit deviates by 1 unit
primary_comparisons.T4: after one half-step: every potential but the pool's against the start (1e-12 of max|phi|), V_b (retrieval) or V_k (recycling) against the closed form (relative 1e-12, here with the floor: max(1e-12, 10 x floor)), the single route's booked heat against C_b dC (V_b - V_k)^2/(2 (C_b + dC)) (relative 1e-9); R1's owner shift V_k dC/(C_k - dC) (relative 1e-9)
primary_comparisons.T5: the operator-level cycle's N and R per half-step against the closed forms (relative 1e-13), N + R (1e-14); both directions: Kir's N only, relative error at 4 ms, n = 8 and 16: 3.5 < err(8)/err(16) < 4.5 and err(16) < 1e-4, the Lie plant below 2.5; here also the scheme's own N at n = 8 and 16 to float64 floors; compiled: the closed forms at each observation (1e-12)
primary_comparisons.T6: per half-step: |dG_chem + dU_view + H - W_res - W_elec - W_carriers| <= 1e-9 max|term| + 1e-18 pJ; the carriers' work against the independent value (relative 1e-6, absolute 1e-15 max|term|); a held bath (retrieval): electrode transfer = -F sum z supplied, electrode work = phi_b x transfer (1e-14), reservoir work = 1e-3 sum mu supplied (1e-12); two routes: each route's work its pool's change plus its |amount| share of the cleft's (1e-6), shares 1:2 (1e-3)
primary_comparisons.T8: per Kir population: F x availability x abundance x area (m^2, abundance = N/(A rho)) = start x A(t)/A0 (relative 1e-12), start = 1/2 x availability x abundance x A0 (relative 1e-14)

zero_power.what: the potentials and the heat in the compiled worlds (cycle, t8_sheet)
zero_power.why: they depend on the pumps, leaks and channels, which these references do not model; only the units, areas and capacitances are referenced there

zero_power.what: T1's refusals, T2's idleness and T7's restart and batch equalities
zero_power.why: rules and bitwise equalities, with no number to reference (T7's batch worlds get T5's closed forms only)

zero_power.what: a dropped valence or swapped transference numbers, in the declared worlds
zero_power.why: both declared carriers are +1 at t = 0.5; the stress worlds (K 0.7, M at z = -1 0.3) carry those plants

zero_power.what: the per-species against the per-total sharing of a free node's free energy
zero_power.why: both routes on the declared shared cleft move K and Na in one ratio (1:2), so the two rules agree; the stress worlds keep one route per node

zero_power.what: the electrode and reservoir work's phi_b parts at a bath held at 0 V
zero_power.why: zero there; held_bath_cell (20 mV) and the stress worlds carry them

zero_power.what: recycling into a patch on a free node
zero_power.why: only the dense route exists for its heat; no registered drive does it
no test compares them (§13); they are registered as the §4 share for completeness
